name: ui.transformerEditor
description: TransformerEditor on the Miroir application: renders the default transformer and its result, edits it, chooses a transformer type, switches the input type restriction off, builds nested transformers (mapList to strings and objects, a reduce of a mapList, a list from an object), wraps transformers in new ones at any level with the type filter of #383, pipes them into new ones, unwraps and removes them, keeps what fits on a type change, and hints at getFromParameters reads after a wrap (#415).
